description:
Vox.md turns speech into clean, useful text on your Mac.

Record directly from the macOS app or menu bar, import audio and video files, pick the local model that fits your workflow, then copy or export transcripts as notes. Your audio and transcript data stay on your device.

—

HOW IT WORKS

Open Vox.md, choose a Vox preset, and start recording. Vox.md captures audio locally, transcribes it on your Mac, saves the result to your history, and can export formatted notes to the folders and templates you choose.

—

FEATURES

• On-device transcription — powered by local Whisper and Parakeet models
• Menu bar recording — start and stop without breaking focus
• Global hotkey — capture ideas from anywhere on your Mac
• Audio and video import — transcribe existing files
• Vox presets — route meetings, journals, tasks, and ideas into separate workflows
• Transcript history — browse, search, copy, and reuse past dictation
• Flexible exports — save TXT, Markdown, JSON, or YAML notes with optional audio attachments
• Apple Intelligence enrichment — generate titles, tags, cleaned text, and smart folders on supported Macs

—

New Capture and transcription require paid access. Choose Individual or Family: weekly, yearly, or lifetime. Eligible subscriptions include a seven-day free trial, then renew automatically at the displayed price until canceled in Apple Account settings. Existing purchases remain valid. Viewing and exporting existing history require no new purchase.

—

PRIVACY

Vox.md is built for private transcription. Audio processing happens on your Mac using local machine learning models. No audio recordings, transcripts, or personal voice data are sent to Vox.md servers. Microphone access is used only when you actively record or import audio for transcription.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://vox.isolated.tech/privacy.html
